label: PORTFOLIO / LAB
content:
locals {
  bastion_prefix = coalesce(var.subnets.bastion, var.subnets.mgmt)
}

resource "azurerm_network_security_group" "mgmt" {
  name                = "${var.name}-nsg-mgmt"
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.this.location
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.this.name
  tags                = var.tags

  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowBastionInboundSSH"
    priority                   = 100
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "Tcp"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "22"
    source_address_prefix      = local.bastion_prefix
    destination_address_prefix = var.subnets.mgmt
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowOnPremisesInboundSSH"
    priority                   = 110
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "Tcp"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "22"
    source_address_prefixes    = var.on_premises_address_spaces
    destination_address_prefix = var.subnets.mgmt
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowAzureLoadBalancer"
    priority                   = 120
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = "AzureLoadBalancer"
    destination_address_prefix = "*"
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "DenyInboundInternet"
    priority                   = 4096
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Deny"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = "Internet"
    destination_address_prefix = "*"
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowOutboundAzureMonitor"
    priority                   = 100
    direction                  = "Outbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = var.subnets.mgmt
    destination_address_prefix = "AzureMonitor"
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowOutboundEntraID"
    priority                   = 110
    direction                  = "Outbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = var.subnets.mgmt
    destination_address_prefix = "AzureActiveDirectory"
  }
}

resource "azurerm_network_security_group" "app" {
  name                = "${var.name}-nsg-app"
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.this.location
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.this.name
  tags                = var.tags

  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowMgmtInboundHttps"
    priority                   = 100
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "Tcp"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "443"
    source_address_prefix      = var.subnets.mgmt
    destination_address_prefix = var.subnets.app
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowOnPremisesInboundHttps"
    priority                   = 110
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "Tcp"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "443"
    source_address_prefixes    = var.on_premises_address_spaces
    destination_address_prefix = var.subnets.app
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "DenyInboundInternet"
    priority                   = 4096
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Deny"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = "Internet"
    destination_address_prefix = "*"
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowOutboundHttps"
    priority                   = 100
    direction                  = "Outbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "Tcp"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "443"
    source_address_prefix      = var.subnets.app
    destination_address_prefix = "Internet"
  }
}

resource "azurerm_network_security_group" "data" {
  name                = "${var.name}-nsg-data"
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.this.location
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.this.name
  tags                = var.tags

  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowAppInboundData"
    priority                   = 100
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "Tcp"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_ranges    = ["1433", "5432", "3306"]
    source_address_prefix      = var.subnets.app
    destination_address_prefix = var.subnets.data
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowMgmtInboundSsh"
    priority                   = 110
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "Tcp"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "22"
    source_address_prefix      = var.subnets.mgmt
    destination_address_prefix = var.subnets.data
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "DenyInboundInternet"
    priority                   = 4096
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Deny"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = "Internet"
    destination_address_prefix = "*"
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "DenyOutboundInternet"
    priority                   = 4096
    direction                  = "Outbound"
    access                     = "Deny"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = var.subnets.data
    destination_address_prefix = "Internet"
  }
}

resource "azurerm_subnet_network_security_group_association" "mgmt" {
  subnet_id                 = azurerm_subnet.mgmt.id
  network_security_group_id = azurerm_network_security_group.mgmt.id
}

resource "azurerm_subnet_network_security_group_association" "app" {
  subnet_id                 = azurerm_subnet.app.id
  network_security_group_id = azurerm_network_security_group.app.id
}

resource "azurerm_subnet_network_security_group_association" "data" {
  subnet_id                 = azurerm_subnet.data.id
  network_security_group_id = azurerm_network_security_group.data.id
}
